facts.fact: 1. Arrivals 重逢：revolving door 出机如 departure into a different world；Tove bedraggled；Mara 开车夜袭（扑倒熊抱、Nag Champa 香味）——You missed the Ursids, you bitch（drive 上 sort of saw it）。
2. 四月分离：亲见的 brown eyes 治愈未察觉的旧伤——这是两人初次相识以来分开最久的一次。
3. Mara 见 Kieran：appallingly good-looking / Maragatham. Pleased to meet you in the flesh / Fuck with Loren and this face’ll be the last one you ever see——威慑握手；Astonishing that you're a real person。
facts.anchor: the last one you ever see

facts.fact: 4. 世界差异：Rena/Lucas 一起取行李（Together, he notes）；父母不在（破晓时分+守夜到晚）——We come from very different worlds；Kieran 的 tight unconvincing smile（望着 Tove/Mara）。
5. 告别时刻：Should he kiss him goodbye? Would he be able to stop if he started?——Not quite allowing himself the step forward——I guess this is it. For now.
6. 结尾钩子：Kieran 表情 transform——笑容满溢 mischief——Well. Not quite.
